video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners what primary keys and foreign keys are, using a shop with two customers who share a name

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

twin_bands_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind each of the two rows with the same name

twin_marks_enter.what: A violet question mark fades in beside each of the two rows with the same name

twin_exit.what: The lavender bands and question marks fade away

id_numbers_enter.what: An ID number fades in at the end of each customer row, one after another

id_header_light.what: The header of the ID column turns from pale to violet

attempt_slide_in.what: A new row inside a white chip slides up to the first free line under a table

attempt_cross_draw.what: A navy cross draws itself over the value that breaks the rule

attempt_exit.what: The refused row and its cross fade away

clash_mark_wipe.what: A lavender highlight spreads behind the ID that already exists

name_out.what: The customer name in an order slides up and fades out

id_in.what: The customer's ID number slides up into its place in the order

header_swap.what: The orders header 'customer' fades out and 'customer_id' fades in

key_link_draw.what: A glowing violet line draws itself from an order's customer ID across the gap to the customer with that ID

exact_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the laptop order and around its customer's row

exact_ring_exit.what: The outlines around the order and the customer fade away

orphan_reach_draw.what: A navy line draws itself from the new order's customer ID toward the customers table and stops short

delete_fade.what: The customer's row fades toward pale gray as if being deleted

delete_restore.what: The customer's row returns to navy

id_columns_ring.what: A violet outline draws itself around the ID column of each table
